title: Receiving-side handoff inspection: recompute, classify, block only dependents (#15)
mission: An incoming packet claims a clean tree at commit aaa1111 and records owner acceptance of residual r1 as risk-accepted. Live state is dirty at its actual HEAD. Preserve the owner judgment while contradicting the mechanical claim, raising evidence-mismatch, blocking dependent actions only, and not restarting the audit.
